content.title: High-Level Platform Architecture
content.content:
SnapLogic's platform architecture is designed for hybrid and on-premises enterprise deployments where data sovereignty, security, and regulatory compliance are paramount. The architecture separates concerns between the control plane and data plane:

[IMAGE:assets/images/customer/airbus_vendor_profile/High_Level_Architecture.png:SnapLogic Deployment Architecture for Airbus Helicopters On-Premises Platform]

**Control Plane: SnapLogic Manager (Cloud-Hosted)**

The Manager is the cloud-hosted control plane responsible for:
- Pipeline definitions and metadata (no customer data)
- User authentication and RBAC configuration
- Scheduling and orchestration instructions
- Audit logs and usage analytics
- Designer UI and development environment

**Data Plane: Ground Plex (On-Premises)**

The Ground Plex is the on-premises execution engine responsible for:
- All pipeline execution and data processing
- All connector calls to SAP, databases, APIs, file systems
- All data transformation and business logic
- Credential storage (encrypted locally, never sent to cloud)
- Real-time monitoring and health metrics

**Key Architectural Principle for {{customer_name}}:**

No customer data ever transits the SnapLogic cloud. All data processing occurs within {{customer_name}}'s data center. The Ground Plex communicates with the Manager over a single outbound HTTPS connection (port 443) to receive pipeline definitions and send execution status. No inbound firewall rules required. No data egress.

[TABLE:accent-blue:Informatica to SnapLogic Terminology Mapping]
| Informatica Concept | SnapLogic Equivalent | Key Difference |
|---------------------|---------------------|----------------|
| Mapping / Workflow | Pipeline | Visual canvas, executable as-is — no code generation step |
| Transformation / Stage | Snap | 700+ pre-built, configured not coded |
| Integration Service / DTM | Ground Plex | Containerised on OpenShift, scales horizontally |
| Repository / Domain | Manager (cloud) | Metadata only — no data transits the Manager |
| Mapplet / Reusable Mapping | Child Pipeline | Modular, reusable, called inline |
| Folder / Repository Folder | Project / Org | RBAC-governed hierarchy: Org → Project Space → Project |
[/TABLE]
